count.text: about 300 in a cell: the proteins of the ribosome were measured at a median of 300 copies in a cell, by mass spectrometry

size.says: The viewer's own measure from the entry's coordinates, by tools/measure_particle.py: each subunit as the ellipsoid of the same spread as its polymer atoms (model 1): along each of its own three axes a half-width of the square root of five times the atoms' variance; the farthest atoms beside it. The frame: origin at the centre of both subunits' atoms; y from the large subunit's centre to the small one's; x the whole particle's longest axis made square to y (the next one if the longest runs along y); z = x × y. The Protein Data Bank states no size.
size.whose: No entry of the Protein Data Bank for its own ribosome is named in the papers its file rests on: it is drawn at E. coli's measure.

surface.definition: each part as one solid: the closed surface that holds its residues' own volume (0.135 nm³ for each amino acid, 0.32 nm³ for each nucleotide), protein and nucleic acid together, in a cloud where each residue is spread as a Gaussian 1.6 nm wide weighted by its volume, on a grid 1.6 nm apart; of a surface in pieces, its largest and every piece of at least 5% of its volume are kept, smaller ones dropped, each listed in the shape's file; for two tones, that solid divided where the nucleic acid's share of the cloud is the greater and where the protein's is (under tones, each inside the solid or on it)
